justification: Inspected all classes under `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/toplist/` and the only external consumers in `ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/toplist/TopListStage.java` and `TopListWrapper.java`. The package has limited fan-in from the UI layer, while its main dependencies are shared, broader utilities: `CompilationUtil` is imported by `hotthrow`, `intrinsic`, `toplist`, `report`, `bytecode`, `ui`, and tests; `TreeVisitor` is imported by `toplist`, `histo`, `report`, `compilation`, and `launch`. The dependency set therefore does not show `toplist` depending on packages that are clearly less stable than itself.
